name: jevis
description: Lessons, tool checks, and visual reviews for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Lessons and checks for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Jevis adds relevant lessons, checks tool calls, and reviews visual work before a coding agent finishes. Local hooks require Node.js 22+, a configured decision model, and explicit hook trust. The bundled skill helps change and test lessons.
defaultPrompt: Use Jevis to add and test a lesson for this repository.
